capabilities: Detect unresolved wiki links in the current file, a selection, or a whole folder
Create missing linked files in bulk with a confirmation dialog
Route new files to folders and templates via filename-pattern rules
Populate new files with template variables and Templater
Preserve link aliases in the new files' frontmatter
extras: Only supports Wiki-style [[link]] syntax, not standard Markdown links [text](link); the FAQ covers this limit and duplicate-alias pitfalls.
motivation: The author wrote long documents (e.g. novels over 3,000 words) where links like [[Character Profiles]] appear before the files exist, and wanted to generate them without creating files one by one.
problem: Writing long notes leaves many [[links]] pointing to files that don't exist yet, and Obsidian only resolves them after you create each file manually.

relations.evidence: Integrates with the Templater plugin for more powerful template functionality

summary: File creator that detects unresolved wiki links in notes and batch-creates the missing Markdown files, with rules for target folders and templates.
